_comment: EXISTING wire on main 1fabf392 (#407, harden-recovery-code-digest design D10, measured PLT-SEC-16; owning living spec `mfa-recovery-code-redemption`). One recovery-code mint per user per Mfa:RecoveryCodeMint:MinInterval (default 10 s, per replica), shared by the four mint routes. The refusal is checked AFTER each route's own credential checks. Frozen for the console: status 429 and a Retry-After header in whole seconds, >= 1. The `error` value is PROSE and illustrative (ApiError.code is null): never render it. Routes: mfaSetup = POST /api/v1/auth/mfa/setup; authRegenerate = POST /api/v1/auth/mfa/recovery-codes/regenerate; enrollVerify = POST /api/v1/profile/security/mfa/enroll/verify; profileRegenerate = POST /api/v1/profile/security/recovery-codes/regenerate. Nothing was minted by a refused request. All four routes are refused during an impersonation (ImpersonationGuardMiddleware.cs:43-52).
